en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional Dutch windmill beside a canal. Several small boats are moored along the canal bank in the foreground. To the right stands a brick farmhouse or building with a tiled roof and a chimney. The windmill dominates the central background with its large sails and adjacent outbuildings. Handwritten and printed Dutch text appears at the top of the image identifying the mill and its location.
